items.title: Stella Lefty Accused Of Copying A Third Hit Song
items.summary: Everyone's having a great time talking about the funniest new character on the pop landscape. The suddenly omnipresent country-adjacent folk-pop hitmaker Stella Lefty is otherwise known as Stella Lefkofsky, the daughter of Groupon's billionaire co-founder. That would already been a silly enough backstory, but it gets even goofier when you consider just how often Lefty's personality-deficient songs seem to be directly lifted from other people's extremely famous hits. items.title: Bill Orcutt :: Four Louies Live
items.summary: Orcutt’s deconstruction of “Louie Louie” is a mash-up of Steve Reich’s 1970 minimalist milestones “Four Organs” with the rock staple. It finds a seam between experimental, avant garde repetition and the dumb but beautiful way that garage rock can hammer on a riff forever. The piece first emerged as a studio album on Fake Estates in 2024. This live recording revisits the piece in all its organ-stabbing, maraca-shaking glory. The post Bill Orcutt :: Four Louies Live first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
